title: Visual oracle E2E for Blur, Glow, and Bevel filters
description: visual-oracle.spec.ts has only one filter test (Test 7: drop shadow at 20% mismatch threshold). Blur (ID=1), Glow (ID=2), and Bevel (ID=3) filters are fully encoded in packages/swf/src/filters.ts and accepted by FiltersPanel.tsx, but have no Ruffle visual oracle acceptance tests. Add three new test cases to visual-oracle.spec.ts: (1) Blur filter — white rect with blurX=8/blurY=8; (2) Glow filter — coloured rect with blurX=6/blurY=6, color=#ff0000, strength=2; (3) Bevel filter — rect with blurX=4/blurY=4. Each test must build a fixture doc inline, capture stageShot vs ruffleShot, and assert mismatch < 0.20. Also lower the drop-shadow threshold from 0.20 to 0.15 if it passes reliably.
